statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Agent Card response includes a capabilities field containing extendedAgentCard set to true, indicating support for an authenticated extended card.

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: capabilities.extendedAgentCard is a boolean field in the Agent Card capabilities object; when true it signals that an authenticated extended card is available.

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Agent Card response includes a securitySchemes field mapping scheme names to security scheme definition objects.

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: A security scheme entry inside securitySchemes contains an openIdConnectSecurityScheme object.

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: openIdConnectSecurityScheme contains an openIdConnectUrl field specifying the OpenID Connect discovery configuration URL (e.g. https://accounts.google.com/.well-known/openid-configuration).

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Step 1: Client fetches the public Agent Card via GET /.well-known/agent-card.json; server responds with an Agent Card whose capabilities.extendedAgentCard=true and securitySchemes define the required authentication scheme.
actions: Client sends GET /.well-known/agent-card.json HTTP/1.1 to Host: example.com
Server returns Agent Card containing capabilities.extendedAgentCard=true and securitySchemes with OpenID Connect scheme entry
